title: EOMasters Newsletter #041
description: A hand-picked selection of news from the field of EO and RS
html:
EOMasters Newsletter #041

09/02/2025

Hello EO-Masters!

This time I have some disappointing news for you. This is the last issue of my newsletter. However, this is not the end of my updates. The newsletter received a good uptake at the beginning, but the number of new subscribers has stalled. Collecting and writing the news requires significant effort, and I want to focus my energy on other things, like the software, where it has more value for you.

If you are still interested in the latest news, you can follow me on social media, where I will continue to share updates about EOMasters and other interesting developments.

So, for the last time

Tschüss and Goodbye!

Marco
